title: PosQ-MAE: few-electrode electrocardiographic imaging with a position-queried masked autoencoder
description: Code and trained weights for the paper Sixteen electrodes approximate full-vest electrocardiographic imaging in real-world clinical recordings. PosQ-MAE (position-queried masked autoencoder) completes body-surface potential maps from a few electrodes; the repository also contains the missing-channel detector, the preprocessing, the method-of-fundamental-solutions inverse, activation/repolarisation marker extraction, the evaluation and statistics scripts, the simulator and the configuration of every reported experiment. Released under the MIT License.
